---
description: 'Organization coding standards for TypeScript functions and component properties'
applyTo: '**/*.{ts,tsx,astro}'
---
# Lab coding standards

- Add TSDoc to every exported function. Describe its purpose, parameters, return value, and observable error behavior.
- Define explicit Props types for components and document each property so consumers understand its purpose and constraints.
- Preserve existing repository patterns and avoid unrelated refactoring.
- Update or add focused tests when behavior changes.
